## RTX - Software Engineer – Technical Publication Systems

🔗 [Apply](https://careers.rtx.com/global/en/job/01878000)

📍 Type: Remote

### Stack & Responsibilities
- Software Engineer building and maintaining publication systems for Pratt & Whitney military aircraft-engine documentation. Developing full-stack software, supporting S1000D compliance, and improving automated publishing.
Software Engineer building technical publication systems for Pratt & Whitney military aircraft engines
- Salary: $86,800 - $165,200 per year
- Tech stack: Apache, Azure, Cloud, Java, JavaScript, Jenkins, MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle, Python, React, SQL
- Collaborate with Military Engine Programs to support software systems for creating, publishing, distributing, and presenting technical documents
- Manage customer expectations and keep project scope and direction on schedule
- Improve and maintain internal platforms for automated and on-demand publication of technical data
- Support dependent engine programs to ensure on-time release deliveries
- Troubleshoot and resolve software issues to improve publishing performance
- Design, build, test, and implement scalable front-end and back-end software
- Write clean, functional code
- Prepare and maintain technical software-development documentation
- Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of experience, or Advanced degree with 3+ years of experience in Aftermarket industry supporting business operations
- Must be a U.S. Citizen
- Familiarity with Waterfall and Agile project management methodologies
- Experience with GitHub, JIRA, or other code management and product management software
- 5+ years of experience in software development
- 3+ years as a Full Stack Developer
- Proven experience with Python, Java, HTML5, CSS3, XSLT, JavaScript, and Apache web servers
- Proficiency in user-centered design (UI/UX) principles

### Full Job Description
Summary:
Software Engineer building and maintaining publication systems for Pratt & Whitney military aircraft-engine documentation. Developing full-stack software, supporting S1000D compliance, and improving automated publishing.
Software Engineer building technical publication systems for Pratt & Whitney military aircraft engines
Role description:
• Collaborate with Military Engine Programs to support software systems for creating, publishing, distributing, and presenting technical documents
• Manage customer expectations and keep project scope and direction on schedule
• Improve and maintain internal platforms for automated and on-demand publication of technical data
• Support dependent engine programs to ensure on-time release deliveries
• Troubleshoot and resolve software issues to improve publishing performance
• Design, build, test, and implement scalable front-end and back-end software
• Write clean, functional code
• Prepare and maintain technical software-development documentation
• Collaborate with Military Engine Programs to implement S1000D-compliant technical data standards in a subsidiary authoring suite
• Review and update technical publication Base of Estimates as needed
• Track status, content, and funding cycles for each engine program
Role requirements:
• Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of experience, or Advanced degree with 3+ years of experience in Aftermarket industry supporting business operations
• Must be a U.S. Citizen
• Familiarity with Waterfall and Agile project management methodologies
• Experience with GitHub, JIRA, or other code management and product management software
• 5+ years of experience in software development
• 3+ years as a Full Stack Developer
• Proven experience with Python, Java, HTML5, CSS3, XSLT, JavaScript, and Apache web servers
• Proficiency in user-centered design (UI/UX) principles
• Knowledge of responsive design and cross-browser compatibility
• Strong knowledge of React.js, including components, state management, hooks, and lifecycle methods
• Experience with databases such as Oracle, MySQL, and MongoDB, including SQL data retrieval
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Ability to work independently
• Preferred: Master’s degree in computer science or engineering with background in Maintenance Data Engineering
• Preferred: Experience with Pratt & Whitney IETP or IETM systems
• Preferred: Experience with S1000D or other XML/SGML specifications
• Preferred: Experience with CORENA or other technical authoring/publication software
• Preferred: Experience with Jenkins or other CI/CD software
• Preferred: Ability to design and develop APIs
• Preferred: Hands-on cloud computing experience, preferably Microsoft Azure
• Preferred: Experience designing and implementing AI-driven solutions, including Databricks or Snowflake and Kobai
• Preferred: Agile project management skills
Benefits:
• Medical insurance
• Dental insurance
• Vision insurance
• Life insurance

• Long-term disability
• 401(k) match
• Flexible spending accounts
• Flexible work schedules
• Employee assistance program
• Employee Scholar Program
• Parental leave
• Paid time off
• Holidays
• Annual short-term and/or long-term incentive compensation programs may be available
• Employee referral award may be available
Tech stack:
Apache, Azure, Cloud, Java, JavaScript, Jenkins, MongoDB, MySQL, Oracle, Python, React, SQL
